scope: Prospective analysis rules frozen while OFF/OFF pilot runs; no outcomes used for endpoints/limits. Statistics run in a separate temporary environment, original project/Windows NumPy untouched.
AA_groups: 8 ON/ON whole fresh process pairs at250ms/4Hz with8 reads

confirmation_rule.chosen_once: Use precision_plan from both completed A/A groups; fixed cap and no outcome-driven extension

equivalence.outliers: All retained; no post-hoc normalization, trimming, success replacement or adaptive optional stopping

drift: Rank trend|rho|>=.7 and p<.05 is a warning that blocks readiness; absence of flag does not prove stationarity.
limits: Student t assumes suitable pair-error stationarity and independence. Prospective A/A estimation does not prove Gaussian tails. Even passed offline equivalence cannot qualify GUI/vision/SDK/USB full field load or fine time shares below the error budget.
